defaults.runAnswer:
## Card payments broke on tablets in release 4.12

Checkout conversion fell from 3.4% to 2.7% last week, a 21% drop [1]. All of it comes from the payment step on tablets, 41% of checkouts [2].

- Tablet conversion halved, from 3.5% to 1.8%
- Phones and desktops held steady at 3.3%
- 4.12 moved the card form into a frame without the payment permission [3]

```tsx
<iframe
  src={cardFormUrl}
  allow="payment"
/>
```

**Fix:** add the permission and ship 4.12.1 today.

meta.help: The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Pixel grid wipe
description: Plays the first clip, then the second, joined with a pixel grid wipe transition. Tip: cut where the picture is still.

meta.help: Grid column count.
Grid row count.
Which axis or point the cells light up from.
Cells fill as blocks, or as points that grow with their own reveal.
0 pops every cell together; 1 spreads them across the whole window.
The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Frosted glass wipe
description: Plays the first clip, then the second, joined with a frosted glass wipe transition. Tip: cut where the picture is still.

meta.help: Frost panel blur radius.
Sweep panel width as fraction of frame.
Sweep direction.
Tint of the glass panel.
The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Colour split slide
description: Plays the first clip, then the second, joined with a colour split slide transition. Tip: cut where the picture is still.

meta.help: Axis the scenes slide along and the channels separate on.
Share of the frame the scenes travel. Below 1 shows background.
The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Blinds
description: Plays the first clip, then the second, joined with a blinds transition. Tip: cut where the picture is still.

meta.help: Horizontal slats stack top to bottom and sweep sideways.
Number of slats. Above ~24 it stops reading as slats at 1080p.
Share of the window the cascade spans. 0 opens every slat together.
Reverse alternate slats for a woven counter-sweep.
Soft leading edge per slat, as a share of its length.
The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Shape morph
description: Plays the first clip, then the second, joined with a shape morph transition. Tip: cut where the picture is still.

meta.help: Shape the reveal starts as, at zero size. A raw path d also works.
Shape it has become once it covers the frame.
Where the shape grows from, 0→1 of the frame width.
Where the shape grows from, 0→1 of the frame height.
Final size as a multiple of the frame diagonal. Leave empty to grow each shape until it covers the frame.
0 keeps the silhouette crisp.
The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so neither clip loses screen time. The result gets longer by the transition.

title: Light leak cut
description: Cuts between two clips under a warm light flare.

title: Music
description: Background music under the video, with fades.

meta.help: Skips the start of the song.
Change volume and left–right balance over time. Edit them here or on the timeline.

title: Sound effect
description: A sound at a set time.

meta.help: Plays when this browser action happens in the clip the sound is added to, even after you record again or edit the clip.
Negative plays it before the action, for sounds that build up to it.
Music set to lower under other sounds stays at full volume for this one.
Change volume and left–right balance over time. Edit them here or on the timeline.

title: Add sound
description: Puts sounds under a clip. Connect as many as you like. Sound stops where the clip ends.

title: Sequence
description: Plays clips one after another, with a transition between each.

meta.help: The transition plays over a still of the last and first frames, so no clip loses screen time. The sequence gets longer by each transition.
Use another transition before some clips. The others use the transition above.
The transition plays over a still of the two clips' last and first frames.

title: Layers
description: Stacks clips on top of each other: Layer 1 at the back, the last at the front.

meta.description: Keep this layout in other shapes
meta.help: In 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5 the layers stay arranged as they are here, scaled to fit, so marks drawn over a picture stay on it.

title: Trim
description: Keeps only part of a clip.

title: Repeat
description: Plays a clip several times.

title: Delay
description: Starts a clip later.

title: Speed
description: Plays a clip faster or slower.

title: Fit length
description: Makes a clip a set length, or as long as a sound, by speeding up, holding or cutting.

meta.help: Ignored when a sound is connected.

title: Choose by variable
description: Uses the first clip when a variable has a value, or the value you give, otherwise the second. Handy for A/B versions.

meta.help: Leave empty to use the first clip whenever the variable has a value.

title: Media file
description: A video, image or sound from your project. Drop files on the canvas to add one.

meta.help: How long the image stays on screen.
Change opacity, position and size over time. Edit them here or on the timeline.

title: Use as clip
description: Turns a file into a clip you can place in the video.

meta.help: Change opacity, position and size over time. Edit them here or on the timeline.

title: Trim file
description: Cuts a file down to a start and end. Makes a new file.

title: Join files
description: Joins files end to end. Fast when they match, otherwise converts them. Makes a new file.

title: Change speed
description: Speeds a file up or slows it down. Makes a new file.

title: Reverse
description: Plays a file backwards. Makes a new file.

title: Resize
description: Resizes a file, adding bars or cropping to fit. Makes a new file.

meta.help: A video takes even sizes; an odd one loses a pixel.
A video takes even sizes; an odd one loses a pixel.

title: Convert
description: Saves a file in another format or quality. Makes a new file.

title: Apply grade
description: Applies a colour grade to a whole video or image file: everything in the picture, window and backdrop included. Makes a new file.

title: Make GIF
description: Turns a video into a GIF with clean colours. Makes a new file.

title: Extract sound
description: Saves the sound of a video as its own file. Makes a new file.

title: Even out volume
description: Makes the sound as loud as most online videos. Makes a new file.

title: Grab frame
description: Saves one frame of a video as an image. Makes a new file.

title: Web-ready
description: Prepares a video to start playing instantly on the web. Makes a new file.

title: File info
description: Shows a file's length, size, frame rate and format.

title: Export video
description: Renders the final video, one file per shape (16:9, 9:16…).

meta.help: Players list the film's chapters, taken from its Chapter actions.
Also saves the chapter times as text, to paste into a video's description. It needs at least three chapters of ten seconds or more.
The graphics card is about ten times faster. Use Software if exports fail.

title: Export images
description: Saves a frame as images at social sizes: wide, link preview, square, portrait, story.

meta.help: The graphics card is about ten times faster. Use Software if exports fail.

title: Export as code
description: Saves this video as an editable code project for developers.

title: Group
description: Boxes nodes together. Select nodes, then Group.

title: Note
description: A sticky note on the canvas. Not part of the video.
